testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-amount-off-order-coupon-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify amount off order coupon functionality

scenario.summary: A guest empties the cart, adds one simple product, applies an Amount Off Order coupon and checks the flat discount and order total. A registered user then signs in, re-applies the coupon on the merged cart, checks the discount again, and cleans up. No order is placed.
steps: Parse the expected flat discount from test data (discountAmount)
Guest: add sku1 with quantity 1 and open the cart (1 line item)
Read subtotal, discount and order total; check discount equals the flat amount and order total equals subtotal minus discount
Sign in as the registered user and open the cart (1 line item)
Remove the coupon and apply couponCode again
Check the success message, coupon row and discount again
Remove the coupon, empty the cart and log out
stateChanges: Guest cart: emptied, product added, coupon applied (removed at cleanup)
Registered user's cart: coupon removed and re-applied, then cart emptied at cleanup
No order is placed, so no coupon redemption is consumed
assertions: Coupon success message equals '- ' + promoAppliedSuccesssMessage (guest and signed-in)
Promo coupon row contains couponCode (guest and signed-in)
Discount label is visible (guest and signed-in)
Discount is close to the flat discountAmount, precision 2 (guest and signed-in)
Order total is close to subtotal minus discount, precision 2
Empty cart message is visible after cleanup
Sign-in link is visible after logout
evidence: Title: 'verify amount off order coupon functionality'

Step labels: '1) Guest: add the product and apply the order coupon', '2) Verify the flat discount and order-total math', '3) The order coupon also applies after signing in (user29)', '4) Clean up the cart and log out'
Profile: sku1 z-4567890 is an active SimpleProduct with inventory 999876 (2 rows matched, store null)
Profile: couponCode ORDER15 is an Amount Off Order promotion on store MaxwellsHardware, availableQuantity 9824
No checkout or place-order call in the step list
The test asserts discount against data.discountAmount (15.00), passed as the COUPON_AMOUNT_OFF_ORDER param discountAmount
